# ForgeFlow Developer Contribution Terms

**Version:** `2026-09-IR`

These terms are a short-form electronic acknowledgement for contributors who receive access to the private ForgeFlow repositories. They supplement, and do not replace, any mandatory employment rights or a separately signed employment, contractor, confidentiality, or IP agreement.

## 1. Purpose of access

Access to ForgeFlow, including `ForgeFlow-AI-Core`, is granted solely so the contributor can perform assigned development, engineering, testing, documentation, security, operations, or related project duties.

Repository access, commits, pull requests, reviews, authorship attribution, contributor status, issue activity, or other technical participation do **not** by themselves create any equity, partnership, revenue-share, co-founder status, commercial ownership, or proprietary interest in ForgeFlow.

## 2. Economic rights in assigned work product

To the fullest extent permitted by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran, transferable/economic rights in software and other work product created specifically within the contributor's assigned ForgeFlow duties are assigned to, or where applicable vest in, **Hossein Rahimi**, as the current founder, employer/commissioning party and recipient of ForgeFlow project IP.

This acknowledgement is intended to confirm the parties' understanding of the economic-rights allocation applicable to commissioned or employment-related software work under Iranian law. It does not attempt to transfer rights that Iranian law makes non-transferable.

## 3. Moral rights

Nothing in these terms transfers or waives non-transferable moral rights of a software creator under Iranian law. Attribution and other non-transferable moral rights remain subject to applicable law.

## 4. Pre-existing and third-party material

A contributor must disclose any pre-existing code, library, model, prompt collection, dataset, design, document, invention, or other IP that they intend to incorporate into ForgeFlow before incorporation when ownership or licensing could affect ForgeFlow.

Third-party or open-source material may be used only when its licence is compatible with ForgeFlow policy and the contributor has authority to use it. A contribution must not knowingly include material copied without permission.

## 5. Confidentiality and repository handling

Private ForgeFlow source code, credentials, architecture, product plans, customer/user information, internal documentation, security information, deployment details, prompts, models, and other non-public material must be used only for authorized ForgeFlow work and must not be disclosed or republished without authorization.

Access revocation does not authorize retention, disclosure, publication, or use of confidential copies after the engagement ends.

## 6. Future incorporation

ForgeFlow is currently an unincorporated startup project. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the contributor acknowledges and agrees that Hossein Rahimi may later assign or transfer the economic rights and contractual benefits obtained under these terms to a company incorporated to own or operate ForgeFlow, without that transfer creating any equity or ownership right for the contributor.

## 7. Electronic acceptance

The repository's Legal Gate requires the contributor to post the exact acceptance statement below from the same GitHub account that authors the pull request:

`I have read and accept the ForgeFlow Developer Contribution Terms v2026-09-IR.`

The parties intend that authenticated electronic acceptance, together with GitHub's account, timestamp, pull-request and audit records, form an electronic record of acceptance. Whether a particular electronic record satisfies any higher evidentiary standard for a "secure electronic signature" depends on the circumstances and applicable Iranian law.

## 8. Mandatory employment protections

These terms do not waive mandatory rights or obligations arising under Iranian labour, social-security, tax, or other mandatory law. If the contributor is legally an employee, the employment relationship remains subject to applicable mandatory rules regardless of repository access or this acknowledgement.

## 9. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the **Islamic Republic of Iran**. Unless the parties later enter a valid separate dispute-resolution agreement, disputes are subject to the competent authorities and courts determined under applicable Iranian law.

## 10. Version changes

Acceptance applies only to the version stated above. A material update must use a new version identifier and the Legal Gate will require a new acceptance.
